      (AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.projPreimage M i)
AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.preimage_mod.doc:
**The fibre of the modification over `Uᵢ` is `Vᵢ`.**

The inclusion `Vᵢ ⊆ π⁻¹(Uᵢ)` is proper over `Uᵢ`, hence universally closed since `π⁻¹(Uᵢ)`
is separated over `Uᵢ`; and `Vᵢ` contains `U∞`, which is dense in `X'`. So `Vᵢ` is a closed
dense open subscheme of `π⁻¹(Uᵢ)`, hence all of it.
(blueprint: `lem:chow-preimage`)

AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.modification.doc:
**The modification `π : X' ⟶ X`** obtained by gluing the restrictions
`pᵢ|_{Vᵢ} : Vᵢ ⟶ Uᵢ ⊆ X` of the projections of the graph over the open
`X' = ⋃ i, Vᵢ` of the graph.

The morphisms being glued agree on the scheme-theoretically dense open `U∞`, where they are
all the inclusion of `U∞` in `X`, and `X` is separated over `S`; this is enough by rigidity
of morphisms into a separated scheme.
(blueprint: `lem:chow-glue`)

AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.isProper_mor.doc: **The modification is proper over each member of the family.**

AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.exists_isClo.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.exists_isClosedImmersion_over.{u, u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Finite ι]
  {X S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : X ⟶ S} {U : ι → X.Opens}
  (M :
    (i : ι) → AlgebraicGeometry.ProperClosedModel (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (U i).ι f)) :
  ∃ N,
    ∃ (_ : Finite N),
      ∃ g,
        AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion g ∧
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g (AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace N S ↘ S) =
            AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.over M
AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.exists_isClo.doc:
**The graph is a closed subscheme of a single projective space over `S`.** Composing the
closed immersion `Z ⟶ ∏_S ℙ(Mᵢ.n; S)` of `AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.emb` with the `m`-fold
Segre embedding `AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace.exists_isClosedImmersion_pi` yields a closed
immersion of `Z` into a projective space `ℙ(N; S)` with `N` finite, compatible with the
structure morphisms over `S`.

The index type `ι` of the cover lives in an arbitrary universe, while the Segre embedding is
stated for an index type in the universe of the schemes; the two are matched up by reindexing
the product along an equivalence `ι ≃ ULift.{u} (Fin k)`.

AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.emb.doc: The closed immersion of the graph into the product `∏_S ℙ(Mᵢ.n; S)`.

AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.doc:
**The graph of a finite open cover**: the scheme-theoretic image `Z` of the tuple
morphism `U∞ = ⋂ i, Uᵢ ⟶ ∏_S ℙ(Mᵢ.n; S)` assembled from the closed models `Mᵢ` of the members
of the cover.

It is a closed subscheme of `∏_S ℙ(Mᵢ.n; S)` (`AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.emb`), hence proper
over `S` (`AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.isProper_over`), it contains `U∞` as a
scheme-theoretically dense open subscheme (`AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.toGraph`) and it maps
properly to each closed model (`AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGraph.proj`).

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineSpace.isOpenImme.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineSpace.isOpenImmersion_toRelativeProjectiveSpace.{u} (n : Type u)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineSpace.signature:
def AlgebraicGeometry.AffineSpace.{u} (n : Type u) (S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme) :
  AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineSpace.doc:
`𝔸(n; S)` is the affine `n`-space over `S`.
Note that `n : Type u` is an arbitrary index type (e.g. `ULift.{u} (Fin m)`).

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.toProject.doc:
The projective embedding `e_I : Bl_I(Spec A) ⟶ ℙ^σ_A`, obtained by applying `Proj` to the
graded surjection `ρ_I : A[T] ↠ 𝓡_A(I)`.
(blueprint: `def:nagata-affine-blowup-projective-embedding`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.map_awayA.doc:
The extended ideal of the centre on the chart at `(a·X)·w` is generated by the image of
`a`. (blueprint: `lemma:nagata-chart-extended-ideal-principal`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isRegular.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isRegular_awayAlgebraMap.{u} {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {I : Ideal A}
  {a : A} (ha : a ∈ I) {e : ℕ} {w : ↥(reesAlgebra I)} (hw : w ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading I e)
  {x : ↥(reesAlgebra I)} (hx : x = AlgebraicGeometry.reesX I a ha * w) :
  IsRegular ((AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.awayAlgebraMap I x) a)
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isRegular.doc:
On the chart at `(a·X)·w`, the image of `a` is a non-zerodivisor.
(blueprint: `lemma:nagata-chart-generator-regular`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isPullbac.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isPullback_hom_of_isLocalization.{u} {A : Type u} (B : Type u)
  [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] (s : A) [IsLocalization.Away s B] {I : Ideal A}
  {J : Ideal B} (h : Ideal.map (Algebra.algebraMap A B) I = J) :
  CategoryTheory.IsPullback (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.hom (Algebra.algebraMap A B) h)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.toSpec J) (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.toSpec I)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Algebra.algebraMap A B)))
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isPullbac.doc:
**The affine blow-up commutes with localization**: for `B = A[1/s]` and `J = I·B`, the
blow-up square is a pullback. (blueprint: `prop:nagata-affine-blowup-restrict`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isProper_.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isProper_toSpec.{u} {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
  (hI : I.FG) : AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.toSpec I)
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isProper_.doc:
**Properness of the affine blow-up**: the blow-up of `Spec A` along a finitely
generated ideal is proper over `Spec A`.
(blueprint: `lemma:nagata-affine-blowup-proper`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isLocaliz.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isLocalization_away_map.{u} {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
  [Algebra A B] (s : A) [IsLocalization.Away s B] {I : Ideal A} {J : Ideal B}
  (h : Ideal.map (Algebra.algebraMap A B) I = J) (a : A) (ha : a ∈ I) :
  IsLocalization.Away
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.awayAlgebraMap I (AlgebraicGeometry.reesX I a ha)) s)
    (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading J)
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading.hom (Algebra.algebraMap A B) h)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.reesX I a ha)))
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isLocaliz.doc:
**Chart-wise localization**: if `B = A[1/s]` and `J = I·B`, then on the chart at a
degree-one element `a·X` the induced map of chart rings
`Away (reesGrading I) (a·X) →+* Away (reesGrading J) (φ(a)·X)` is the localization away
from the image of `s`. (blueprint: `prop:nagata-rees-localization`, chart form)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isIso_toS.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isIso_toSpec_of_eq_top.{u} {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {I : Ideal A}
  (h : I = ⊤) : CategoryTheory.IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.toSpec I)
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isIso_toS.doc:
The blow-up of the unit ideal is trivial: the structure morphism is an isomorphism.
(blueprint: `lemma:nagata-affine-blowup-top`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isClosedI.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isClosedImmersion_toProjectiveSpace.{u} {σ A : Type u} [CommRing A]
  {I : Ideal A} (f : σ → A) (hf : ∀ (i : σ), f i ∈ I) (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) :
  AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.toProjectiveSpace f hf hspan)
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.isClosedI.doc:
**The affine blow-up embeds as a closed subscheme of projective space**: if `I` is
generated by `f`, the morphism `e_I` is a closed immersion.
(blueprint: `lemma:nagata-affine-blowup-projective-embedding`, closed-immersion part)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.hom_comp.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.hom_comp.{u} {A B C : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing C]
  {I : Ideal A} {J : Ideal B} {K : Ideal C} (φ : A →+* B) (ψ : B →+* C) (h : Ideal.map φ I = J)
  (h' : Ideal.map ψ J = K) :
  AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.hom (ψ.comp φ) ⋯ =
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.hom ψ h')
      (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.hom φ h)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.hom.doc:
Functoriality of the affine blow-up: a ring homomorphism `φ : A →+* B` with
`I.map φ = J` induces a morphism `AffineBlowup J ⟶ AffineBlowup I`.
(blueprint: `def:nagata-affine-blowup-restriction-map`, generalized)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.exists_un.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.exists_units_awayAlgebraMap_eq_mul.{u} {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
  (I : Ideal A) (a b : A) (ha : a ∈ I) (hb : b ∈ I) :
  ∃ u,
    (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.awayAlgebraMap I
          (AlgebraicGeometry.reesX I a ha * AlgebraicGeometry.reesX I b hb))
        b =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.awayAlgebraMap I
            (AlgebraicGeometry.reesX I a ha * AlgebraicGeometry.reesX I b hb))
          a *
        ↑u
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.exists_un.doc:
On the overlap of the standard charts at `a·X` and `b·X` — that is, on the chart at
`(a·X)·(b·X)` — the images of `a` and `b` differ by a unit.
(blueprint: `lemma:nagata-chart-generators-associated`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.exists_is.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.exists_isClosedImmersion_comp_projectiveSpaceOverAffineToSpec.{u}
  {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {I : Ideal A} (hI : I.FG) :
  ∃ σ,
    ∃ (_ : Finite σ),
      ∃ e,
        AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion e ∧
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp e
              (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveSpaceOverAffineToSpec σ A) =
            AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.toSpec I
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.exists_is.doc:
**The affine blow-up along a finitely generated ideal factors through a projective
space over `Spec A` by a closed immersion.** This is the content of the blueprint's
projectivity statement that can be phrased in this Mathlib; see the module docstring for why
projectivity itself cannot.
(blueprint: `prop:nagata-affine-blowup-projective`, closed-immersion-plus-factorization
form)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.closure_r.signature:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.closure_range_awayAlgebraMap_union_range_awayMap.{u} {A B : Type u}
  [CommRing A] [CommRing B] {I : Ideal A} {J : Ideal B} (φ : A →+* B) (h : Ideal.map φ I = J)
  (x : ↥(reesAlgebra I)) (hx : x ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading I 1) :
  Subring.closure
      (Set.range
          ⇑(AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.awayAlgebraMap J
              ((AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading.hom φ h) x)) ∪
        Set.range ⇑(HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading.hom φ h) x)) =
    ⊤
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.closure_r.doc:
**The base-changed blow-up chart is generated by the two canonical images**
(Stacks Project Tag 080E, affine chart layer; blueprint:
`thm:nagata-strict-transform-is-blowup`): for a ring homomorphism `φ : A →+* B` with
`I.map φ = J` and a degree-one element `x` of the Rees algebra of `I`, the chart ring
of the blow-up of `J` at `φ(x)` is generated as a ring by the image of `B` and the
image of the chart ring of the blow-up of `I` at `x`.

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.chart.signature:
def AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.chart.{u} {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
  (x : ↥(reesAlgebra I)) (hx : x ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading I 1) :
  AlgebraicGeometry.Spec
      (CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (AlgebraicGeometry.reesGrading I) x)) ⟶
    AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup I
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.chart.doc:
The affine chart of the blow-up at a degree-one element `x` of the Rees algebra.
(blueprint: `prop:nagata-affine-blowup-chart`)

AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.signature:
def AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.{u} {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) :
  AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
AlgebraicGeometry.AffineBlowup.doc:
The blow-up of `Spec A` along the ideal `I`, defined as `Proj` of the Rees algebra
of `I`. (blueprint: `def:nagata-affine-blowup`)

Algebra.IsStandardEtale.exists_algEquiv_.signature:

Algebra.IsStandardEtale.exists_algEquiv_.doc:
Every standard etale algebra over a quotient `R ⧸ I` is the base change of a standard etale
algebra over `R`.
